# f5xc_site_state (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the operational readiness and state of an F5 Distributed Cloud Customer Edge (CE) site. This manual data source queries the core site object directly in namespace `system`, allowing automation workflows to verify whether a CE is `ONLINE`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Automation Workflow Example: Wait for CE to become ONLINE before deploying workloads

# 1. Provision the CE (e.g. AWS VPC Site)
resource "f5xc_aws_vpc_site" "example" {
  name      = "my-aws-ce"
  namespace = "system"
  # ... site configuration ...
}

# 2. Query operational state of the CE site
data "f5xc_site_state" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_aws_vpc_site.example.name
  namespace = "system"
}

# 3. Assert CE is ONLINE before continuing dependent operations
resource "terraform_data" "wait_for_ce_online" {
  input = data.f5xc_site_state.example.is_online

  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.output == true
      error_message = "CE site ${data.f5xc_site_state.example.name} is not online yet! Current state: ${data.f5xc_site_state.example.site_state}"
    }
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Basic Example: Query CE site state
data "f5xc_site_state" "example" {
  name      = "my-ce-site"
  namespace = "system"
}

output "ce_site_state" {
  value = data.f5xc_site_state.example.site_state
}

output "ce_is_online" {
  value = data.f5xc_site_state.example.is_online
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the site configuration object. It must match the name of the provisioned site (e.g. AWS VPC site, SecureMesh site).

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the site object. Site objects reside in namespace `system`. Defaults to `system`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the site, formatted as `<namespace>/<name>`.
- `is_online` (Boolean) Convenience boolean flag that evaluates to `true` when `site_state` is `ONLINE`. Useful for conditional checks in automation workflows.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) List of master/main nodes belonging to the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `operating_system_version` (String) Underlying operating system version running on the site.
- `site_state` (String) Operational state of the CE site reported by the platform. Possible values include `ONLINE`, `PROVISIONING`, `UPGRADING`, `STANDBY`, `FAILED`, `REREGISTRATION`, `WAITINGNODES`, `DECOMMISSIONING`, `WAITING_FOR_REGISTRATION`, `ORCHESTRATION_IN_PROGRESS`, `ORCHESTRATION_COMPLETE`, `ERROR_IN_ORCHESTRATION`, `DELETING_CLOUD_RESOURCES`.
- `site_type` (String) Type of the site as registered in F5 Distributed Cloud (e.g. `CUSTOMER_EDGE`, `REGIONAL_EDGE`).
- `software_version` (String) F5 Distributed Cloud software version currently active on the site.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the node.
- `sli_address` (String) Site Local Inside (SLI) IP address.
- `slo_address` (String) Site Local Outside (SLO) IP address.
